conclusion.phenomenon: Outbound dependency timeout (ETIMEDOUT) causing request failure
conclusion.causal_chain: A request failed with ETIMEDOUT, and the causal trace confirms the error originated from a dependency and propagated without local rejection or independent failure. No other error types or root causes are present in the evidence.
conclusion.alternatives: The timeout could originate from network infrastructure, DNS resolution, TLS handshake, or the remote service being unreachable or overloaded — all unobserved and indistinguishable from this log alone.
conclusion.contradictions: No evidence contradicts the dependency timeout hypothesis; no logs show local processing errors, configuration faults, permission denials, or resource exhaustion.
missing: Dependency endpoint identity (e.g., hostname, service name)
Network-level telemetry (e.g., DNS, TCP connect, TLS logs)
Dependency health or availability metrics during the period
recommendations: Identify the timed-out dependency using correlation_id and request context
Check network connectivity and DNS resolution to the dependency endpoint
Review dependency service status and latency metrics for the same time window
Validate timeout configuration values (connect/read) against observed behavior
conclusion.boundary: 真实模型分析；模拟日志来源。模型判断不是因果证明，建议不会自动执行。
